CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: G2-17516: Product Sold Out
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On the Shopping Bag, have an item that is unavailable (sold out) in the cart response. Confirm a dedicated 'Unavailable items' section renders, separate from purchasable line items, on both desktop and mobile. Test data: BE must mark an item unavailable (e.g. test account faizan.arif.external@mytheresa.com on NAP Acceptance).
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Unavailable items appear in a separate 'Unavailable items' section, visually distinct from active items.
Active items remain in the main list and totals reflect purchasable items only.
Layout renders correctly on both desktop and mobile.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: G2-18883: Cart rectification for country change
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Switch the site country from the country/language selector under three conditions:
1) Empty cart (or no cart): the country switches immediately with no rectification popup and no API call.
2) Cart with items all available in the target country: a brief loader then normal navigation, no popup.
3) Cart with items that become unavailable in the target country: a loader then a rectification dialog listing the unavailable items. For a logged-in user, use the move-to-wishlist action and confirm items move and navigation to the target country completes.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Empty/no cart switches country with no API call and no popup.
With unavailable items, a rectification dialog lists them before switching.
Logged-in user can move unavailable items to wishlist, after which navigation to the target country completes with no cart corruption.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: G2-24191: Quantity selection handling for mini pdp
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
Open the Mini PDP for a bag item and use the quantity selector.
1) For an item with low stock (e.g. only 1 or 3 pieces), confirm you cannot select more than the available stock.
2) For a well-stocked item, confirm the maximum selectable quantity is capped at 10.
3) Force an update failure and confirm an error is displayed.
Test data (NAP): product dolly-105-embroidered-shantung-pumps, colour yellow, size 40 has low stock.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Quantity cannot exceed available stock for low-stock items.
Quantity is capped at a maximum of 10 per item even when stock is higher.
An error message is shown if the quantity update fails.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: G2-25442: Delete unavailableItems In Shopping Bag
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
On the Shopping Bag with items in the Unavailable items section (set an item's stock/on_hand to 0 so it appears unavailable, on NAP and MRP):
1) Click 'Remove All' in the Unavailable items section and confirm those items are removed.
2) With unavailable items present, click 'Continue to checkout' and confirm unavailable items are silently dropped from the cart before entering checkout (return to the bag to verify they are gone).
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
'Remove All' clears items from the Unavailable items section.
Clicking 'Continue to checkout' silently removes unavailable items before checkout begins.
After proceeding, the cart no longer contains the unavailable items and active items are preserved on both NAP and MRP.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Undo flows may desync with order summary in split-shipment scenarios.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Remove item and undo across mixed shipment basket; verify totals and item grouping after each action.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Shipment sections and totals remain consistent after undo.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Risk inferred from remove/undo capabilities and split shipment scope.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Cart merge at login can create duplicate or stale line items.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Prepare guest cart and account cart with overlap, then login and verify merge behavior.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Single merged cart with deterministic quantities and notifications.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Country change rectification may remove restricted items without clear messaging.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Change country with restricted items present and verify messaging and resulting cart content.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Clear rectification message and predictable retained/removed items.
